behavior: Saved-rule and tag markers are pure projections of the committed active Search; no last-clicked state remains.
Portable signatures trim query edges, use the existing ordered filter signature, and omit only device-local availability. Equivalent named rules all match.
The current display context excludes retained Search behind Trash; returning to Files restores the existing markers without another Search read.
Organization reads expose pending/error/retry and retain known rows on failed refresh. Initial enabled, account replacement, and capability-enable first renders are truthful.
Management opens with zero selected files in both adapters and passes shared manage mode. Assignment retains the complete mapped selection for shared validation.
The shared tag wire type includes the actual Server tags:null representation; the sibling-owned TagDialog handles normalization.
Failed fire-and-forget update/delete calls consume the hook-reported rejection without losing original rules or duplicate success/error feedback.
Navigation exposes Manage Tags and portable Save Current Search, readable saved predicates and actionable Favorites/pinned-folder empty guidance.
Failed assignment reads remain unknown; valid tags:null means known empty. Definition versus selected-membership counts and deletion meanings remain distinct.
Tag names honor the existing 64 UTF-8 byte limit. Exact complete unique IDs are validated against the 500-item contract without dropping invalid selected identities.
A committed create followed by rejected assignment retains one definition and retries assignment through that existing row. Pending writes cannot double-submit through Enter or synchronous clicks.
Compact name/color input owners and actions measure at least 44px, including fine-pointer 700/899px. Desktop input owners remain 40px at 900px.
Short-height 200% text uses native content scrolling to reach long error text and Save/Cancel; settled modal close restores the initiating control.
